args.title: Freight Pricing Summary (2026) + Companion Piece
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices rather than a fixed schedule.
- Companion analysis finds shippers who split volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs.
- Combined takeaway: with spot rates soft but volatile, diversifying carrier mix (3-carrier split) appears to be the most effective hedge against pricing swings this quarter.
